_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Saturday — true weekend day but structurally heavy. Recurring framing 'AI is outgrowing its institutions': (1) MAD Bugs hits 500+ validated high-severity vulnerabilities in first 96 hours — Carlini's Claude-powered pipeline now empirical anchor for Mythos disclosure; capability is not gated by special model access, falls out of publicly available Claude Sonnet/Opus given right harness. (3) Iran-linked strikes physically disrupt AWS Gulf-region data centres — first major kinetic-conflict event materially disrupting AI inference capacity, hits Bedrock-dependency footprint disproportionately; AI sovereignty pitches (Mistral, SAP+Anthropic, DeepSeek/Huawei) suddenly concrete. (4) Anthropic acquires biotech startup ~$400M as 'in-house Mythos for biology' capability buy — sets up GPT-Rosalind (16 April) parallel science-vertical play. Claude Code clean-room rewrite forks cross 50K GitHub stars in two hours — fastest-growing OSS repo in GitHub history is a clean-room rewrite of a frontier lab's coding agent; Anthropic DMCA wave against ~8,100 repos produces Streisand-effect re-uploads. Kyle Daigle (GitHub COO): 1B commits 2025, GitHub Actions 500M min/week 2023 → 1B 2025 → 2.1B already this week — agentic-coding-boom footprint. Research backfill (Sat no arXiv slot; HF Papers redirects to Friday): SKILL0 + CORAL + Apriel-1.5-OpenReasoner (ServiceNow 15B reasoning model, 30-50% shorter traces via difficulty-aware length penalty) + Signals (DigitalOcean trajectory triage) + GPA (Salesforce vision-only single-demo GUI agent beats Gemini 3 Pro on process replay) + Investigating Autonomous Agent Contributions in the Wild + Executing as You Generate (55% latency reduction via AST chunking + parallel execution).
